notes.design: Weapon of the gunplay pass (docs/GUNPLAY_SPEC.md), benchmark B: every trigger pull is an event. Absurd damage for a handgun (a head shot kills at any range, a body shot takes nine tenths of a life), savage kick, five rounds, a true first shot that only comes back once the last one has settled (fan it and you miss), and a slow, rhythmic round-by-round reload (each cartridge can be fired as soon as it is in).
notes.model: The Meshy community Revolver Rustique (CC0 per the owner; content/guns.json), replacing the Meshy community revolver (2026-01-26 download), now the fallback.
